messages:
Maya S: heads-up: after yesterday's mixed-precision rollout (FP8 + 4-bit fallback) we see a quality delta on the structured-output eval set for redwood-embed-13b. JSON outputs sometimes have truncated keys / shifted fields. failing tests ~2.3% vs baseline 0.1%
Jordan K: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro and any runtime logs?
Maya S: repro is the canary: model=redwood-embed-13b, mode=mix-quant, calib=per-layer, routing=auto. quick log snippet:
```
serve: select_kernel: chosen=fp8_fused_v2 fallback=int8_generic at layer=14
warn: kv_cache_pad_mismatch detected pad=3 expected=0 (seq_len drift)
trace: output_tokens len mismatch expected=42 got=40
```
Maya S: also seeing an incr in CPU memcpy and a couple of kernel fallback warnings mid-request.
Priya R: kv_cache_pad_mismatch + mid-sequence fallback -> token shift makes sense. maybe fp8 accum overflow caused runtime to switch kernel for that layer. which calib profile did you use?
Maya S: used nightly calib: /calib/profiles/2026-03-16/mixcal-v3.json (per-layer clip).
Alex G: can you run with --profiler=layerwise --kv-debug and collect kernel_choice log + device_util counters? suspect a quantized matmul path is hitting saturation and runtime falls back to int8_generic which has different output rounding.
Maya S: attaching short perf excerpt:
```
layer 13: kernel=fp8_fused_v2 time=1.8ms gfops=240
layer 14: kernel=fallback=int8_generic time=3.6ms gfops=110 (cpu memcpy 0.6ms)
KV cache ops: extra_pad_resolve count=8
```
Jordan K: showing a fallback half-way through the attention stack will change kv positions if pad handling differs — explains JSON keys moving.
Priya R: quick mitigation: pin that model's rollout to int8 or force use_fp8=false in config and re-run calibration with tighter clip_range (try clip_range=0.06). Also we should add a runtime assert that prevents kernel switching in-flight for a request (or at least re-run kv alignment).
Maya S: will create a canary pinned to int8 and compare eval diffs. also going to run a calipatch with clip_range=0.06 and --kv-debug.
infra-bot: deployment notice: canary created redwood-embed-13b-canary-2026-03-18 (pinned=int8) by Maya S :white_check_mark:
Alex G: one hypothesis: our kernel selection heuristic picks fp8_fused when estimated dynamic_range < threshold, but the per-batch activation tail causes overflow after prefix tokens — need to incorporate seq-pos-aware calibration into selector.
Jordan K: agree. short-term: pin to int8 for the customer-facing models. medium-term: we should add a calibration pass that samples longer sequences and a runtime safety margin to avoid in-flight fallback.
Priya R: I'll file a perf/qa ticket with the repro and add the eval delta to the regression board. include the kernel_choice logs and kv_debug traces.
Maya S: thanks. action items: 1) canary pinned to int8 (done), 2) run tighter calib (Maya), 3) add runtime guard ticket (Priya), 4) follow-up perf run with --kv-debug + layerwise profiler (Alex/Jordan). will post results here when available :eyes:
Jordan K: noted. ping me if you want extra GPUs for repro runs.
Maya S: will do, thx everyone.
